title: RSSB REET 2025 Result: Out for 7759 Primary & Upper Primary Teacher Posts #RSSBREET2025 #REET2025 #SarkariNaukri
intro: Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB-Jaipur) has Officially Released Result for the Post of Primary/ Upper Primary Teacher (Level-1 & 2) Recruitment 2025 for 7759 Post. Exam Held On January 17-20, 2026 & Answer Key Released  January, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Result Now in the Given Link Below.

				OR

Graduation with at least 45% marks and 1-year Bachelor in Education (B.Ed) as per NCTE Regulations.
				OR

Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks and 4-year Bachelor in Elementary Education (B.El.Ed).
				OR

Senior Secondary (or equivalent) with at least 50% marks and 4-year B.A./B.Sc.Ed or B.A.Ed/B.Sc.Ed.
				OR
Post-Graduation with 55% marks or equivalent grade and 3-year integrated B.Ed-M.Ed.
Must have passed the Rajasthan Eligibility Examination for Teacher (REET Level-II / RTET) as per latest government orders.
The candidate must have studied the concerned subject as an optional or main subject in graduation or post-graduation.
For Social Studies Teacher, at least one of these subjects must be studied: History, Geography, Economics, Political Science, Sociology, Public Administration.
For Maths & Science Teacher, the candidate must have studied Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Zoology, Botany in graduation or equivalent.
All teacher training degrees (D.El.Ed/B.Ed/B.A.Ed/B.Sc.Ed) must be NCTE-recognized.
Candidates must fulfill all eligibility criteria by the last date of application.
5% relaxation in marks is applicable for reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC/EWS etc.).
Candidates must be medically fit as per government standards.
Pay Scale: Pay Level-10
Mode of Selection: As Per Rule
